steps.title: What the arrow shows
steps.say: The green arrow points from the old demand curve D1 toward the new one, D2. It shows the whole demand curve shifting to the right.

ops.text:
Arrow = shift
of the demand curve

steps.title: Why a shift right
steps.say: Rightward means more buyers want the product at every price, for example because of higher income or a trend.

ops.text:
Right = more quantity
demanded at every price

steps.title: What happens next
steps.say: The new curve D2 crosses supply higher up, so equilibrium moves to a higher price and a larger quantity.

ops.text:
New equilibrium:
P2 is higher than P1
